app_fee.value: International applicants pay a non-refundable CAD$120 application fee, by credit card only.
app_fee.quote: The application fee of CAD$60 for Canadian applicants or CAD$120 for international applicants is payable by credit card (Visa or Mastercard) only

fee_waiver.value: No application-fee waiver for international applicants is listed on the pages checked.

gre_general.value: No GRE General requirement is listed for science PhDs; the apply page names GRE only for some management and psychology programs.

toefl_min.value: The default TOEFL iBT minimum is 80 overall; some graduate programs require 92.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL: An aggregate score of 80 (92 for graduate programs with higher English proficiency requirements)

ielts_min.value: The default IELTS Academic minimum is an overall band of 6.5; some programs require 7.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS Academic: An aggregate score of 6.5 (7 for graduate programs with higher English proficiency requirements)

english_waiver.value: A degree taught in English at a recognized institution waives the test, but the page does not name India, so confirm with the School of Graduate Studies.
english_waiver.quote: Students who have completed secondary schooling, an undergraduate degree, or a graduate degree at a recognized institution where the language of instruction is English are not required to take an English proficiency test

notes: Source conflicts: the School of Graduate Studies acceptance page (https://www.mun.ca/sgs/new-students/acceptance-process/) still gives a $40 application fee, older than the CAD$120 on the apply page, which is used here. Chemistry lists $100 for international applicants and its record overrides the fee. Several department pages were blocked or 404 (see the program notes).
